copied_inputs: All small originals copied; the three large local replay artifacts are hash-indexed at their original paths without unnecessary duplicate storage.
mechanisms: Before parsing the response or metadata, capture and fsync the actual declared RPC bytes; preserve complete error responses or partial truncated input.
Metadata pins exact repository/blob request, payload SHA/Git blob/length and original-part identity; caller separately proves commit/tree membership.
Publish payload only at canonical data_root+exact transport_path; receipts outside data tree and no overwrite.
Canonical base64 strict decode/re-encode; plain JSON original UTF8 is preserved with exact reversible string-token codec.
Reopen original RPC, payload, prefix/suffix and part before final successful receipt; failure never yields completion credit.
scope_boundaries: The four controls are existing local PTY controls; first replays a previously returned actual large RPC, others are explicit fixtures with zero commit/tree labels.
This review did not invoke receiver or make any network/desktop/native call, and does not validate a future Git publication.
No cross-file atomicity or protection against hostile concurrent filesystem writers is claimed. A failed later write may leave payload files without a success receipt.
Caller must wait READY before sending, transmit exact UTF8 bytes, reconcile unknown process status and retain any pre-READY rejected tool response.
